text:
jordan: seeing a spike of TLS handshake failures on ingress-prod (us-west-2) since 09:05 UTC. 500s for a bunch of services that talk to customers. Logs show 'tls: bad certificate' and occasional KMS AccessDenied during keystore unwrap. Any RBAC/keystore changes rolled in recently?

laura: :eyes: looking. No cert rotation MR on prod in last 24h from infra-certs. There was an RBAC tweak to keystore roles merged 08:58 by infra-helpers (PR #4127) — could be related.

eva: rolling logs from the proxy show repeated: `error=handshake_failure cipher=TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384 server_name=svc-api-usw2` and this line from sidecar: `kms:Decrypt error AccessDeniedException principal=system:serviceaccount:ingress:proxy-sa key=projects/redwood/kms/keystore`

mike-ops: confirming, I see the same pattern across 3 node pools. Sidecar fails to unwrap private key, falls back to ephemeral cert but then upstream rejects. That explains 'bad certificate'.

carmela: who merged that RBAC change? if serviceaccount lost kms:decrypt binding we'd hit this.

laura: PR author was @infra-helpers (scripted update). It removed a broad `roles/kms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` grant and applied a more specific IAM condition. Possibly condition doesn't evaluate in cross-region nodes.

jordan: nice catch. Is there a quick mitigation? can we reapply old binding or add temporary key decrypt grant to the proxy SA?

oncall-ops: I can patch a temporary rolebinding now for the region. Applying `gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding KEYPATH --member=serviceAccount:ingress:proxy-sa@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` to us-west-2 key will be quickest.

mike-ops: prepping the command. Confirming key path: projects/redwood/locations/us-west2/keyRings/keystore/cryptoKeys/ingress-priv

sec-bot: automated alert: recent IAM change detected on projects/redwood at 2024-11-13T08:58:12Z. Change author: infra-helpers. Tagged as "privilege_narrowing".

laura: We should be cautious about re-broadening IAM perms. Temporary grant for 1 hour + runbook entry. After service stabilizes, refine condition in PR to include cross-region node identities.

carmela: Agreed. Mike, can you add a 1-hour binding and then rotate keystore access logs to verify decrypts succeed?

mike-ops: Applied temporary binding in us-west2 at 09:21 UTC. Commands: 
```
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/redwood/locations/us-west2/keyRings/keystore/cryptoKeys/ingress-priv \
  --member=serviceAccount:proxy-sa@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter
```

mike-ops: Restarted affected proxy sidecars in the region (`kubectl rollout restart ds/proxy-ingress -n ingress`) to pick up re-unwrapped keys.

jordan: errors dropping immediately, latency back to normal within 2 mins :thumbsup:

eva: logs show successful `kms:Decrypt` calls now. Sample: `INFO kms:Decrypt success principal=proxy-sa key=ingress-priv time_ms=24`

laura: good. Next steps: revert temporary grant (reminder: one-hour expiry) and open a remediation PR to update the IAM condition so service account identities used by cross-region nodes are included. Also two new items for postmortem: (1) add an automated IAM-change-rollback playbook, (2) add a KMS-decrypt-incident alarm that fires before 5xx spike.

carmela: I'll own the PR to refine the IAM condition and include a test matrix for regional node identities. Assigning to @infra-helpers + me.

oncall-ops: posting followup checklist in #incidents and will leave binding auto-removed (set expiration rule).

sec-bot: Note: we should consider additionally hardening TLS config on proxies to fail open only when explicit compatibility is proven. Current behavior: fail closed if key unwrap fails which caused immediate customer-facing 500s. Logged as CONFIG-472.

jordan: timeline summary for postmortem: 08:58 UTC IAM change narrowed KMS access with condition that excluded some cross-region node identities -> 09:05 UTC first TLS failures -> 09:21 UTC temp binding applied + sidecar restart -> 09:23 UTC traffic stabilized.

laura: can someone capture commands/IDS for runbook? I'll draft a short playbook section: steps to detect KMS decrypt failures, run `kubectl logs -l app=proxy -n ingress --since=10m | grep Decrypt`, check IAM delta, apply temporary binding, restart sidecars, validate with `curl --resolve proxy.example.com:443:10.0.5.9 https://proxy.example.com/ -I --tlsv1.3`.

mike-ops: adding note: if we see `tls: unsupported protocol` or specific cipher negotiation errors, also check upstream cipher list and TLS version enforcement. Use `echo | openssl s_client -connect proxy.example.com:443 -servername proxy.example.com -tls1_3` for low-level handshake debug.

carmela: added to Jira: CONFIG-472 (playbook + IAM test matrix) and SRE-891 (monitor KMS decrypt error rates + alert).

jordan: thanks team. after PR merges, let's schedule a canary-run of the adjusted IAM condition in staging and one non-prod region to validate before rolling to prod.

laura: agreed. I'll also add a small integration test to the cert rotator job that simulates conditional IAM evaluation using short-lived node identities.

sec-bot: Closing triage thread. Recommend postmortem within 72h and include audit log snippets + IAM diff. :white_check_mark:

jordan: ack, will write the postmortem draft and link back here.
